verdict.rationale: React's source is publicly hosted at github.com/facebook/react, and community reports confirm React was relicensed from BSD+Patents to MIT, an OSI open license. A community member also describes reading the React source directly. The patent-grant complaints are about license terms, not whether the source is open, so they do not contradict the story. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license (e.g., a LICENSE file or docs citation) in the evidence, and current-dated confirmation of the MIT terms.
